description: A Peter de Jong strange attractor stepped at audio rate, giving two related waveforms that never quite repeat.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves that pitch. With nothing patched into FQ this knob is a fine tune instead.
The rate the attractor is stepped at, which sets the pitch.
Bends the curve the attractor draws, from stepped through straight lines to a smooth curve.
How much the CURV. jack moves that bend.
The first of the four constants in the de Jong equations.
The second of the four constants in the de Jong equations.
The third of the four constants in the de Jong equations.
The fourth of the four constants in the de Jong equations.
Sets how the steps are joined: up leaves them stepped, middle draws a straight line between them, down draws a curve.

inputs.text: Moves the pitch, by as much as the MOD knob beside FQ allows.
Moves the curve bend, by as much as the MOD knob beside CURVE allows.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the MOD knob acts as a fine tune.
inputs.1:
±6.24V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads an internal chaotic generator.
